stem: How did the First Great Awakening contribute to the rise of representative government in the British North American colonies?

options.label: A
options.text: The rise of religious participation led to people focusing less on politics.

options.label: B
options.text: The focus on equality in religion caused people to question authority.

options.label: C
options.text: Church leaders preached about creating a state ruled by religion.

options.label: D
options.text: Church officials taught about the virtues of monarchy.
